purpose: Teach: ライム/アパレル/ハト/アンティーク/鮎/鮭/トンボ/占い師

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがライムジュースを試されたぞ
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he used to drink lime juice.
lines.style: Gentle, half-lost in memory. Soft opening, no urgency. Slow unfurling of the thought. Warm nostalgia without sadness.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、アパレル商店を始められたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes — and your father started that apparel shop, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Warm and present. Slight tilt of affection in "dear." Not correcting him, just gently opening her own memory alongside his. Conversational, easy.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがお庭でハトを眺めていらしたぞ
lines.en: Gran, when he was young, your father would spend time in the garden watching the pigeons.
lines.style: Same wistful register as before. Slightly more present this time — the memory sharpens. Still unhurried, but with a quieter conviction in the image.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、アンティークの時計を集めてらしたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And he collected antique clocks, didn't he, dear? You remember that.
lines.style: A gentle knowing smile in the voice. She's following his thread but weaving in her own. Not questioning, affirming. The warmth of shared history.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんと川で鮎を釣ったぞ
lines.en: Gran, I remember when we fished for ayu together in that river, your father and I.
lines.style: The memory becomes more vivid. Slower, more grounded. A shift from "he used to" to "I was there." Quieter pride underneath.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、お土産に鮭を持って帰られたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And he brought back salmon for all of us, didn't he, dear? Such a kind thing to do.
lines.style: Tender recognition. The voice carries the weight of small kindnesses remembered. Unhurried. A soft exhale of affection at the end.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが孫にトンボの捕り方を教えられたぞ
lines.en: Gran, when he was young, your father taught our grandchildren how to catch dragonflies.
lines.style: The warmth deepens. A full breath before opening. The pride of legacy — a skill, a moment, a hand reaching forward through time. Present and patient.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、占い師に運勢を見てもらったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And when you were young, you went to a fortune teller, didn't you, dear? To see what lay ahead.
lines.style: Close and intimate. A small smile. She's turned the mirror gently — from his memories to his future once-imagined. Tender curiosity, no judgment. Fading warmly.
